REQUEST FOR REVIEW COMMENTS
TO: Richard Mertens, Environmental Review Officer, B.R.A.

The Council requests that you consider whether this report adequately describes the project's impact upon your community and addresses significant environmental benefits and potential damages. We would appreciate your completing the form below and returning it to us. ATTN: METROPOLITAN CLEARINGHOUSE, by the due date.
COMMENTS DUE: 11/10/76
MAPC PROJECT NUMBER: EIS-76-9
REVIEW COMMENTS:

(Explain Below).

EXPLANATORY COMMENTS:
In general we feel that the Draft Report was well written and comprehensive in its assessment of the proposed project and its impacts on the environment. ur specific comments and questions on the Report have been forwarded to the City of Boston, Office of Community Development.
Environmental Review Officer November 5, 1975
